prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
competitors_mentioned: HealthCare.gov plans and any suitable alternatives
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed person in Kansas City, MO. It says it compares individual Marketplace and private plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves Missouri residents. Its North Kansas City office is at 1327 Burlington St.; call **816-205-4664**. The agency reports a 5.0 Google rating, though ratings and plan availability can change. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

**Apollo Health Insurance** is another local option, based in Lee’s Summit, that says it helps individuals compare Marketplace and other coverage. Call **816-400-4477**. [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/)

There isn’t one “best” broker for everyone: the right fit depends on your income, doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals. When you call, ask whether they’ll compare **HealthCare.gov plans and any suitable alternatives**, check your doctors and medications against the plan network, and explain any commissions or fees. If you’re eligible for income-based savings, make sure you compare Marketplace plans before choosing an off-market plan.
